previous_event_profile.drop_confirmation: confirmed prior bilateral lift, total loss of grasp contacts, relative downward slip, then upward impact on registered ground support; regrasp cancels pending loss
previous_event_profile.notes: Contact deadband is numerical event resolution. Load limits are calibrated per interface/phase, never supplied here. No hardware damage limit is claimed.
previous_event_profile.load_interface: object body + contact category + counterpart body + phase; opposing counterpart forces are never merged
previous_event_profile.jam_command_source: signed TCP displacement from actual applied arm position targets + FK; native OSC_POSE translation action uses its frozen 0.05 m scale; relative to insertion axis, never a stage/intent label
previous_event_profile.force_aggregation: sum of per-contact force magnitudes per interface; net resultant and world-XY magnitude sums reported separately; moments shifted to object origin before vector sum
